snippet.title: Muri: Wildwoods | Release Date Reveal
snippet.description:
Muri: Wildwoods is a cozy cleaning-sim adventure mixing satisfying cleaning with a 3D platformer all wrapped up in a cute visual style *̥ ˚✧

Muri: Wildwoods is coming to Steam this winter December 7th 2026 - Wishlist now!

⇾ Play the demo and Wishlist on Steam: https://bit.ly/MuriWildwoods
⇾ Play Project Shoreline, a mini-adventure featuring Pelle: https://bit.ly/4ebFci3

🎵 Music by Tomas Nyman — https://www.instagram.com/noteboy.prod/
